intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Khanom. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Khanom is a quiet seaside town known for pink dolphins. For the busiest beach with the most restaurants stay at Nai Phlao Beach; for a long, peaceful beach choose Nadan Beach; and for local life near the pier, Khanom town.

faq.q: Where can I see pink dolphins in Khanom?
faq.a: Boats leave from piers around Laem Prathap or Thong Nian in the north of Khanom to look for the pink dolphins that live along the coast; mornings with a calm sea give the best chance. Book a boat tour ahead and remember they are wild animals — some days you see many, some days few.

faq.q: Which Khanom beach is best without a car?
faq.a: Nai Phlao is best without a car, as the stays, restaurants and services are clustered within walking distance, while Nadan is longer and quieter but more spread out and better with a car or motorbike — for convenience, choose Nai Phlao first.

faq.q: Can I reach Koh Samui from Khanom?
faq.a: Yes — Khanom is near the Don Sak piers with ferries to Koh Samui and Koh Phangan, a short drive away, handy if you want to stop in Khanom before or after the islands, or prefer a quiet mainland coast instead of an island.
